title: (0Day) Meta fairseq load_checkpoint_to_cpu Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Meta fairseq. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
The specific flaw exists within the load_checkpoint_to_cpu method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
addtionnal_details:
03/04/26 - ZDI reported the vulnerability to the vendor03/05/26 - the vendor acknowledged the receipt of the report03/17/26 - the vendor communicated that the report was being investigated04/07/26 - the vendor communicated that the fairseq repository is no longer maintained and was archived on March 20, 2024. However, GitHub shows the repository was actually archived on March 20, 2026, after this report was submitted https://github.com/facebookresearch/fairseq10/23/26 - ZDI notified the vendor of the intention to publish the case as a  0-day advisory
-- Mitigation: Given the nature of the vulnerability, the only salient mitigation strategy is to restrict interaction with the product
